name: Board Hero
description: Dark product hero: pulsing brand badge, display headline with a highlighted word, intro and CTA pair over a perspective-tilted browser window holding a live-looking kanban board (three columns, tags, progress bars, avatars) with floating stat tiles, a dot grid and ambient brand glows.
interactions: staged entrance reproducing the reference GSAP timeline with CSS transitions: badge .6s@0, headline .7s@.3s, sub .6s@.6s, CTAs .55s@.85s, board .9s@1.15s, cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1), triggered once at 15% viewport
badge dot pulses (wpmn-bh-pulse 2.4s) with a brand-tinted expanding ring
three stat tiles float forever on offset phases (4.4-5.2s ease-in-out)
task cards lift 1px with border brighten on hover; primary CTA arrow nudges 3px
buttons follow design-system states (primary enable/hovered/pressed + glow; ghost-invert secondary fills on hover)
prefers-reduced-motion: entrance, pulse and floats disabled, content rendered in place
